name: create-pr-comment
description: Post a new comment on a pull request or issue.

github-token.description: GitHub token with permission to write issue comments.

repository.description: Repository in the format "owner/name". Defaults to the current repository.

issue-number.description: Pull request or issue number to comment on. Defaults to the current pull request or issue number.

comment-url.description: HTML URL of the created comment.
